infoExplore: Explore countries, cities and streets. Use the zoom controls or scroll wheel; drag to move the map. Click to choose a location and drag its marker to move it.
infoKeyboard: Tab moves through controls. Arrow keys move the map when it has focus. Choose location lets you enter coordinates. Escape or Back closes the panel.
infoMap: Map detail varies by region. Local detail is unavailable beyond ±85.0511° latitude.
infoSearch: Countries and cities include alternative names and regions. Small settlements may be missing.
countryNameFallback: If no published name is available in the selected language, a local or English name is retained; official street names are not translated.
disclaimerData: Mapa Táctico provides maps and contextual information. Geographic data may be incomplete or outdated. Visual scale does not establish data accuracy.
disclaimerHistory: Historical information retains its sources. An area's population count is not a prediction of injuries or deaths. The portal does not replace official warnings or emergency decisions.
disclaimerMilitary: Military and nuclear events are covered through historical and humanitarian information. The portal does not calculate attacks on real locations.
disclaimerMap: Map queries transmit the tiles required for the current view.
disclaimerSearch: The search uses a catalogue hosted on Sites. The application does not store profiles or individual queries; its quota uses a global counter. Sites and map providers process technical request data according to their policies.
countryOriginal: This name is retained from the original catalog; no verified translation is available.
